start.evidence: Exact anchor to grid movement witness recorded

reachability.explanation: Every valid point is required. Small corner discrepancies are identified, not whitelisted.

zone_joins.explanation: Raw geometry rule and real connection evidence are separate. Zero overlap, gaps and disabled zones are not failures.

interactions.reason: Current active labels sampled; inactive conditional/later labels remain individually UNVERIFIED

method.validity: Player.walkable plus Euclidean circle/rectangle clearance, as requested
method.actual_physics: Existing Player.place/update, including actual AABB collision resolution
method.graph: Four cardinal neighbours; directed, tested parent tree. Reverse edges are never inferred.
method.floor: Height changes are measured separately and never removed from the reach graph.
method.pick: Actual inter.pick, full unmodified registry, exact target identity; legal camera pitch.
limitations: Finite 0.15 m grid and finite aim samples are not a continuous-space proof.
Circle-clear corners may be rejected by the actual AABB resolver; those remain in the requested grid.
No hardware performance or complete chapter playthrough is verified.

movement.parent_format: parents[n] is predecessor of reached_indices[n]; -1 is exact-start witness seed
